items.title: Dow Adds Nearly 550 Points; Chip Stocks Weigh on Nasdaq
items.content: Dow Jones rose 537 points (+1.03%) to 52,747.32 on strong earnings, while Nasdaq edged down 0.22% as chip stocks fell. Oil prices sank amid pause in US-Iran hostilities.

items.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Gains 262 Points on Monday; S&P 500 Flat
items.content: Dow +0.51% to 52,210.08. S&P 500 +0.02% to 7,413.18. Markets relatively flat ahead of Fed decision and earnings deluge.

items.title: S&P 500 Edges Down to 7,425; Month-long Decline Continues
items.content: US500 fell to 7,425 on July 29, losing 0.05%. Down 0.99% over the past month but up 16.69% year-over-year.

items.title: Hang Seng Holds Near 25,196 as Region's Chip Selloff Bypasses Hong Kong
items.content: HSI closed nearly unchanged at 25,196.42, a striking display of calm compared to Korea's Kospi (-10%) and Japan's Nikkei (-4%). Hong Kong relatively insulated from regional chip rout.

items.title: Hong Kong Stocks Open Higher; Tech and Financials Lift HSI
items.content: Hang Seng Index opened up 176 points (+0.69%) at 25,487, driven by tech and financial sectors.

items.title: US Thwarts Iranian Missile Attack on US Troops; Strikes Iranian Proxies in Iraq
items.content: US forces intercepted Iranian missile attack on American troops. US reinstated blockade on Iranian ports has stopped 18 ships. Strait of Hormuz remains contested despite June 2026 MoU.

items.title: Iran Continues Illegal Claim Over Strait of Hormuz
items.content: Iran still asserting hegemonic control over Strait of Hormuz, using naval mine threats to deter commercial vessels from using non-Iranian-approved routes. June MoU not fully implemented.

items.title: Meta Stock Plunges Nearly 10% on Disappointing Guidance
items.content: Meta Q2 earnings: EPS $6.18 vs $7.22 expected. Revenue $60.8B vs $60.17B. Q3 guidance range $61-64B disappointed investors. Free cash flow dwindling, AI spending concerns.

items.title: CXMT Stock Soars 470% on Debut Amid AI Race
items.content: China's leading memory chipmaker Changxin Memory Technologies (CXMT) surged 466% on STAR Market debut, becoming the most valuable company on Shanghai stock exchange. Raised $8.6B in IPO.

items.title: Chip Stock Rout Deepens on AI Debt Jitters, China Competition
items.content: Global semiconductor selloff intensified as China's CXMT listing and signs of progress in China's advanced chipmaking compounded worries about AI spending sustainability. Korea's Kospi collapsed.

items.title: US Inflation Expected to Ease to 3.8% in June, First Slowdown in 5 Months
items.content: US annual inflation rate expected to ease to 3.8% in June from 4.2% in May. CPI forecast to edge down 0.1% month-over-month, first decline since May 2020.

items.title: Fed Projects 2026 PCE at 3.6%, Well Above 2% Target
items.content: Fed's June projections: 2026 PCE inflation at 3.6%, core PCE at 3.3%. Both remain significantly above the Fed's 2% long-run objective.

items.title: Market Risk May Be Underpriced Amid Geopolitical Uncertainty
items.content: Implied volatility remains subdued despite elevated headline risks - suggesting market risk may be underpriced relative to geopolitical uncertainty, sector concentration, and mega-cap earnings dependence.
